item.b: For their defense of Xandar, the criminal records of Peter Quill, Gamora, Drax, Rocket and Groot are hereby expunged. Any further infraction will be prosecuted in full. Corpsman Dey adds that this includes taking things that belong to other people.

item.where: Mar-Vell's laboratory in orbit, and the skies over Earth
item.cause: Hunting the last Skrull refugees and the Tesseract, Yon-Rogg's Starforce storms Mar-Vell's hidden laboratory above the Earth, and Ronan the Accuser's fleet arrives to bomb the planet.
item.out: Carol Danvers breaks the Supreme Intelligence's hold, tears out her Kree implant and, at full power, destroys Ronan's missiles and one of his warships, and the fleet retreats. Maria Rambeau shoots down Minn-Erva, the Skrulls escape, and Carol beats Yon-Rogg in the desert and sends him back to Hala with a warning.
loss: Minn-Erva, shot down by Maria Rambeau.
One of Ronan's warships, destroyed by Carol.
fall: Goose coughs up the Tesseract on Nick Fury's desk.
Captain Marvel
Carol leaves to find the Skrulls a new home and gives Fury a pager to call her in an emergency.
Captain Marvel
Fury drafts a plan for a team of heroes, naming it after Carol's old call sign, Avenger.
Captain Marvel
Fury sends the page as he turns to dust in the Snap.
Avengers: Infinity War

item.where: The carousel, Central Park, New York
item.cause: The Kitchen Irish, the Dogs of Hell and the Mexican cartel meet in Central Park for a deal, while the district attorney's office lets a sting on it go ahead in a crowded park.
item.out: The meeting turns into a three-way shootout near the carousel, where Marine veteran Frank Castle is spending the day with his family. Frank is shot in the head and survives, but his wife and children are killed.
loss: Maria Castle and her children, Lisa and Frank Jr.
fall: Frank starts a one-man war on the gangs behind the shootout.
Daredevil S2
DA Samantha Reyes covers up her part in the botched sting, until it comes out at Frank's trial and she is later shot dead.
Daredevil S2
Frank learns that his old commander, Colonel Ray Schoonover, is the Blacksmith, and kills him.
Daredevil S2
Frank discovers the shooting was meant to kill him, arranged to bury what his unit did in Operation Cerberus.
The Punisher S1

item.where: Oslo, Norway, then the whole universe, in the reality where Ultron won
item.cause: Ultron takes the Mind Stone and Vision's vibranium body, defeats the Avengers and launches the world's nuclear weapons, killing most of humanity.
item.out: When Thanos comes to Earth with the other five Stones, Ultron slices him in half and takes them, then sends his drones out to wipe out nearly all life in the universe. Hearing the Watcher, he learns of the multiverse and attacks him.
loss: Most of humanity, killed in the nuclear strikes.
Thanos, sliced in half by Ultron.
Clint Barton, who gives his life so Natasha Romanoff can escape Ultron's drones.
Nearly all life in the universe.
fall: Ultron chases the Watcher across worlds and beats him, and the Watcher flees to Strange Supreme for help.
What If...?
The Guardians of the Multiverse fire Arnim Zola's mind into Ultron, and Zola destroys him from within.
What If...?

item: Rockefeller Center tree topples during fight

item.b: Every suit I built went up like fireworks last night, and I did it for Pepper. The shrapnel's out of my chest too, so no more arc reactor. I'm still Iron Man. That part doesn't come out.

item.where: The Hong Kong Sanctum, Hong Kong
item.cause: With the London Sanctum gone and the Ancient One dead, Kaecilius's zealots bring down the Hong Kong Sanctum, the last of the three, and the Dark Dimension begins to swallow the Earth.
item.out: Arriving too late, Stephen Strange uses the Eye of Agamotto to turn back time over the ruined city, then goes into the Dark Dimension and traps Dormammu in a time loop until he agrees to leave the Earth alone and take Kaecilius and his zealots with him.
loss: Wong, killed defending the Sanctum before Strange turns back time.
Hong Kong's streets, wrecked and then restored.
fall: Sickened by the sorcerers' rule breaking, Karl Mordo leaves the order.
Doctor Strange
Strange returns the Eye to Kamar-Taj, and Wong reveals it holds an Infinity Stone.
Doctor Strange
Mordo starts stripping sorcerers of their power.
Doctor Strange
Strange gives up the Time Stone to Thanos on Titan to save Tony Stark's life.
Avengers: Infinity War

item.where: Adwa, Ethiopia
item.cause: Italy's army attacks Adwa, and Prince Tafari and Kuda, Wakandan agents, slip into the battle to take a vibranium axe from a merchant's house at its center.
item.out: They get away with the axe, but a Black Panther from the future stops them and shows Tafari Wakanda in ruins, warning that the axe must stay in the outside world if Wakanda is ever to give up its isolation and survive the Horde. Tafari puts the axe back, Kuda is hurt helping him, and the Italians are driven from the ruined town.
loss: The town of Adwa, shelled to ruins.
fall: The axe ends up in a London museum, where Killmonger stands before it, ready to steal it.
Eyes of Wakanda
Killmonger steals the axe from the Museum of Great Britain and uses it to bring himself to Wakanda.
Black Panther

item.where: Bleecker Street, Greenwich Village, New York
item.cause: Ebony Maw and Cull Obsidian land in New York to take the Time Stone from Stephen Strange, just after Bruce Banner has warned him and Tony Stark that Thanos is coming.
item.out: Tony, Strange, Wong and Peter Parker fight them through the streets, and Wong sends Cull Obsidian away through a portal, but Maw captures Strange and his ship leaves Earth with Tony and Peter aboard.
fall: Tony and Peter blow Maw out of his ship into space and rescue Strange, and the ship carries them to Titan.
Avengers: Infinity War
Wong goes back to guard the New York Sanctum.
Avengers: Infinity War
Bruce calls Steve Rogers on the phone Steve left with Tony.
Avengers: Infinity War

item: Prisoner breaks out of the Eastern Regional Detention Center

item.where: Vossoyedineniye Square, Moscow
item.cause: Gravik's Skrull rebels plant bombs in Moscow, meaning to pin the attack on the United States and push humanity toward a war that would leave the Earth to the Skrulls.
item.out: Nick Fury, Maria Hill and Talos chase the bombers through the city but cannot stop the blasts, which tear through a crowded square. In the chaos Gravik, wearing Fury's face, shoots Hill dead.
loss: Maria Hill, shot by Gravik in Fury's form.
fall: Russia blames the United States, and Raava, posing as Rhodes, uses the bombing to push President Ritson toward war.
Secret Invasion
Fury and Sonya Falsworth expose Raava before Ritson can strike Russia, but Ritson then brands every alien on Earth an enemy.
Secret Invasion

key: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#1
item: Government names a new Captain America
Wilson Fisk elected mayor of New York

item.n: The D'Bari Attack on the Prison Train
item.where: A military train carrying captured mutants to a containment facility, New York
item.cause: The cosmic force Jean absorbed in space wiped out the D'Bari world, and their leader Vuk comes to Earth to take it from her. After a battle in New York, troops subdue both the X-Men and Erik's mutants and load them onto a train.
item.out: Vuk's D'Bari overpower the soldiers, and the mutants, freed from their restraints, fight them side by side. Jean takes control of her power, saves everyone from the wreck and disintegrates the D'Bari, then carries Vuk into space, destroys her and vanishes in a burst of fiery light.
loss: Selene and Ariki, killed fighting the D'Bari.
Vuk and the D'Bari attackers, destroyed by Jean.
The soldiers guarding the train, and the train itself.
fall: The school is renamed for Jean Grey, and Charles steps down as Hank takes over.
Dark Phoenix
Charles and Erik make peace over chess in Paris as a phoenix burns in the sky.
Dark Phoenix

item.b: Peter Parker, college student, one year of trouble. That was the whole of it.

item: Former Marine Frank Castle found alive

item.where: The Saints and Sinners club, Tampa, Florida
item.cause: Frank Castle destroys Howard Saint's laundered money, kills the hitmen sent after him and, with Mickey Duka's help, tricks Saint into believing Livia is sleeping with Quentin Glass. Saint stabs Glass to death and throws Livia onto the railroad tracks to die.
item.out: Frank storms the Saints and Sinners club and kills every member of Saint's mob, John among them. He shoots the wounded Saint as he flees, ties him to a car and sends it into the club's parking lot, which he has rigged with explosives.
loss: Quentin Glass and Livia Saint, killed by Howard Saint after Frank's setup.
John Saint and the rest of Saint's men, killed in the club.
Howard Saint, killed in the parking lot explosion.
fall: Frank decides against ending his life, leaves Saint's money to his neighbors and takes the name the Punisher.
The Punisher (2004)

item.b: If you're reading this, you're still here. Get to the compound. We're counting heads, and right now the count is bad.

Welcome to S.H.I.E.L.D., Agent. This datapad logs all your activity, every file you close and every operation you see through. First order of business: pick a codename and insignia in your Agent File. Stay sharp. We're counting on you.

item.where: The Phalanx spire at the Empire State Building, New York City
item.cause: The Phalanx, a race of techno-organic aliens, come to Earth to assimilate all life on it and absorb most of the X-Men, Moira and X-Factor.
item.out: Beast and Forge join the alien Warlock and Mister Sinister to build a virus against them, and Magneto joins them once his son is taken. They carry it into the Phalanx core at the Empire State Building, and Warlock lets himself be absorbed to spread it, destroying the Phalanx and freeing their captives.

item.where: Kamar-Taj, Kathmandu
item.t: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
item.cause: Corrupted by the Darkhold, Wanda Maximoff wants America Chavez's power to reach a universe where her sons live, and when the sorcerers refuse to give the girl up, she storms Kamar-Taj as the Scarlet Witch.
item.out: Wanda breaks through the sorcerers' defenses and kills many of them, and Strange and America escape when America, in a panic, opens a portal into another universe. Sara gives her life to destroy Wanda's Darkhold and break her dreamwalk, and Wanda forces Wong to lead her to Mount Wundagore.
loss: Many Masters of the Mystic Arts.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
Sara, who gives her life to destroy the Darkhold.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
fall: Dreamwalking into Earth-838, Wanda kills most of the Illuminati in their own headquarters.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

item.b: A Punisher at war with Jigsaw. Neither side won.
Bruce Banner has been located in Rio de Janeiro. Emil Blonsky goes in with the team. Bring Banner in alive. Do not let him get angry.

item.where: The streets of San Francisco
item.cause: Hank Pym's lab, shrunk to the size of a suitcase, holds the quantum tunnel he needs to bring Janet van Dyne home, and two others want it: Ava Starr, the Ghost, who hopes its energy will cure her, and the arms dealer Sonny Burch, who wants to sell its technology.
item.out: While Hank goes into the Quantum Realm, Scott Lang and Hope van Dyne chase the lab across the city against Burch's men and the Ghost. Hank brings Janet back after thirty years, Burch and his crew are dosed with their own truth serum and arrested, and Janet eases Ava's pain.
fall: Scott goes into the Quantum Realm to collect healing energy for Ava, and is stranded there when Hank, Hope and Janet turn to dust.
Ant-Man and the Wasp
Five years later, a rat sets off the tunnel in Luis's van and frees Scott.
Avengers: Endgame

item.where: Pym Technologies headquarters, San Francisco
item.cause: Darren Cross is about to sell his Yellowjacket shrinking suit to HYDRA's Mitchell Carson, and Hank Pym sends Scott Lang, shrunk in the Ant-Man suit, into Pym Tech to steal it and destroy Cross's research.
item.out: Scott wipes the servers and the charges set through the building go off, imploding Pym Tech, but Cross escapes with the suit and takes Cassie Lang hostage. Scott fights him in her bedroom and goes subatomic to break into the Yellowjacket, which shrinks out of control and collapses in on Cross, and Scott finds his way back out of the Quantum Realm.
loss: Pym Technologies headquarters, collapsed in on itself.
Darren Cross, crushed inside his own shrinking suit.
fall: Mitchell Carson slips away with a vial of the formula for HYDRA.
Ant-Man
Scott's return from the Quantum Realm gives Hank hope that Janet van Dyne can be found there.
Ant-Man

item.where: The planet Gorth, and New York
item.cause: Infinata, a menace from the fifth dimension, destroys the planet Gorth, and its last scientist flees to Earth with all of his world's knowledge held in a palm-sized orb.
item.out: Spider-Man catches the tiny ship, and the dying scientist gives him the orb. Infinata pulls Spider-Man into the fifth dimension to seize it, until Spider-Man learns that only fear gives Infinata power and escapes.
loss: Gorth and its people, destroyed by Infinata.
The last scientist of Gorth, who dies after reaching Earth.

item.where: HYDRA's Alpine headquarters, and the Arctic
item.cause: Red Skull prepares to bomb American cities from his giant bomber, armed with weapons powered by the Tesseract. Captain America, the Howling Commandos and the SSR storm HYDRA's last base in the Alps to stop him.
item.out: Steve gets aboard as the bomber takes off and fights Red Skull, who grabs the Tesseract and is carried away by its light. With no way to land without setting off the bombs, Steve takes the plane down into the Arctic ice, talking to Peggy until the radio goes dead.
loss: Steve Rogers, lost in the ice and presumed dead.
Red Skull's bomber, crashed in the Arctic.
fall: Searching for Steve, Howard Stark pulls the Tesseract from the ocean floor.
Captain America: The First Avenger
Almost seventy years later, Steve is found in the ice and wakes up in New York.
Captain America: The First Avenger
Red Skull turns up on Vormir as the keeper of the Soul Stone.
Avengers: Infinity War

item.where: The Arête and Knowhere, in deep space
item.cause: The High Evolutionary holds Drax, Nebula and Mantis aboard the Arête, along with the children and animals he has experimented on, and he still wants Rocket's brain back.
item.out: The Guardians break into the ship while Kraglin and Cosmo bring Knowhere into the fight and fire on it. The other Guardians beat the High Evolutionary and Rocket spares him, Cosmo opens a tunnel to carry the captives to Knowhere, and the Arête is destroyed, with Adam Warlock pulling Quill out of space.
fall: The rescued children settle on Knowhere, where Nebula and Drax stay to raise them.
Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
Peter Quill goes home to Earth, and Rocket leads a new team of Guardians.
Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3

item.b: Clint made it home to his family for Christmas. I kept the dog. Hawkeye is still a work in progress, but so is everything.

item: Burning wreckage falls from the sky over rural Russia
2029: Mysterious attack freezes an Oklahoma City casino hotel

item.where: The Illuminati's headquarters, New York, Earth-838
item.t: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
item.cause: From Mount Wundagore, Wanda dreamwalks into her Earth-838 counterpart to reach America Chavez, whom the Illuminati are holding with Stephen Strange.
item.out: Before the Illuminati can pass judgment on Strange, Wanda breaks into their headquarters and kills every member except Mordo. Strange subdues Mordo and flees with America, helped by Earth-838's Christine Palmer.
loss: Blackagar Boltagon, Peggy Carter, Maria Rambeau, Reed Richards and Charles Xavier, killed by Wanda.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
fall: Strange, America and Christine search the space between universes for the Book of Vishanti, but Wanda destroys it and takes America.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
America sends Wanda to Earth-838, where Billy and Tommy recoil from her, and she brings Mount Wundagore down, destroying every copy of the Darkhold.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

item.t: Marvel Super Hero Adventures: Frost Fight!
item.b: Loki tried to ruin the holidays here. Something ruined the rest.
Kaecilius tore pages from the Book of Cagliostro, and the library has logged them as lost. Also, someone has been reading it without permission. We know who you are, Stephen.

item.where: Midtown Manhattan, New York
item.cause: Loki uses the Tesseract to open a portal above Stark Tower and leads a Chitauri army through it.
item.out: The Avengers hold Midtown. Tony Stark flies the World Security Council's nuclear missile through the portal into the Chitauri mothership, the army collapses, and Natasha Romanoff closes the portal with Loki's scepter. Loki is taken into custody.
loss: Phil Coulson, killed by Loki aboard the Helicarrier before the battle.
Coulson's death is later undone by Project T.A.H.I.T.I.
fall: Damage Control takes over the cleanup and shuts out Adrian Toomes's salvage crew. Toomes keeps the Chitauri tech he has already taken.
Spider-Man: Homecoming
Tony Stark suffers anxiety attacks over what he saw through the portal.
Iron Man 3
In 2023, a team of Avengers travels back to the battle for the scepter and the Tesseract. They take the scepter, and the 2012 Loki escapes with the Tesseract.
Avengers: Endgame

item.where: Beneath the Wilder mansion, Los Angeles
item.cause: For years the parents of PRIDE have sacrificed a teenager chosen from Leslie Dean's Church of Gibborim to keep Jonah alive, and their children stumble on the ritual as Destiny Gonzalez is offered up.
item.out: The ritual fails and Destiny is later found dead, so PRIDE sacrifices one of Darius Davis's men instead, reviving Jonah. Their children gather proof, stop PRIDE's drill beneath Los Angeles and reveal their powers to their parents, then run when they are framed for Destiny's murder.
loss: Destiny Gonzalez, chosen from the Church of Gibborim.
Andre, one of Darius Davis's men, sacrificed to revive Jonah.
The teenagers sacrificed before them, year after year.
fall: Catherine Wilder kills Darius and frames him for Destiny's murder, clearing the Runaways.
Runaways S1–S2
In the Dark Dimension, Karolina meets Destiny and the other sacrificed teens.
Runaways S3

item: Strange gravity anomalies reported across London

item.where: New York City Hall, Manhattan, New York
item.cause: Vanessa Fisk's vigil at City Hall turns into a protest against the Task Force's raids, and Karen Page projects the recorded testimony of its prisoners onto the building's walls.
item.out: Connor Powell shoots Alan Saunders, a Task Force officer who has been helping the resistance, and blames the vigilantes in the crowd. The Task Force crushes the protest, and Powell recognizes Karen and arrests her.
loss: Alan Saunders, shot dead by Connor Powell.
fall: At Karen's trial, Matt reveals that he is Daredevil, and Fisk's regime is exposed.
Daredevil: Born Again S2
Fisk resigns and takes a deal to leave New York, and the Task Force's officers are arrested.
Daredevil: Born Again S2

item.n: The Burning of Dr. Faber's Lab
item.where: Dr. Faber's laboratory, New York
item.cause: Silvermane and his men raid Dr. Alethea Faber's laboratory to find more metahumans for his ranks, just after she has made a cure from Ben Reilly's organs.
item.out: Seeing the mutated soldiers Faber failed to save and fired on by her son Ogden, Dirk Leyden kills them both, and the fire that follows blows up the lab. Ben escapes with the cure.
loss: Dr. Alethea Faber and her son Ogden, killed by Dirk Leyden.
fall: Ben makes doses of the cure, and Robbie injects one into Lonnie Lincoln, who leaves town with his mother.
Spider-Noir

item.where: The Paris Peace Accords, Paris, France
item.cause: Raven learns that Bolivar Trask has been experimenting on captured mutants and goes to the Paris Peace Accords to kill him.
item.out: Charles, Hank and Logan stop her before she can, but Erik tries to kill her to change the future and shoots her as she flees. Hank fights him in the street, and the fight exposes mutants to the world.
fall: Trask uses the exposure to win President Nixon's approval for his Sentinel program.
X-Men: Days of Future Past
Magneto takes his helmet back and laces Trask's Sentinel prototypes with steel.
X-Men: Days of Future Past

item.where: New Asgard, Norway, in the reality overrun by zombies
item.cause: Wanda, posing as the Queen of Sokovia, has been sending New Asgard food that is secretly zombie flesh, and when Kamala Khan's group arrives looking for a ship she reveals herself and asks for Kamala's power.
item.out: The Asgardians who ate the food turn, along with Alexei Shostakov, and the zombies overrun the town. Thor holds Wanda off so Kamala's group can escape into space in an Asgardian ship, and she turns him into a zombie.
loss: Helmut Zemo, Death Dealer and Jimmy Woo, killed by the zombies.
Alexei Shostakov and the Asgardians of New Asgard, turned by the tainted food.
Thor, turned into a zombie by Wanda.
fall: In space, the Nova Corps reveal that Earth is under quarantine and shoot the ship down, and the sorcerers of Kamar-Taj rescue the survivors.
Marvel Zombies
The zombie Thor kills Blade and the last defenders in the battle for the Infinity Hulk.
Marvel Zombies

item: Stark refuses to hand the Iron Man suit to the Senate
Iron Man attacked at the Monaco Grand Prix
Hammer drones turn on the crowd at Stark Expo

item.where: Metro-General Hospital, Hell's Kitchen, New York
item.cause: Daredevil frees the children the Hand has been draining of their blood at its farm, and the police take them to Metro-General, where Claire Temple works.
item.out: Hand ninjas scale the hospital and storm the ward, while the children wait for them standing over the body of Stan Gibson, killed by his own son. The ninjas kill a nurse and knock Claire from a window, and Daredevil catches her and fights them off, but the Hand escapes with the children.
loss: Nurse Louisa Delgado, killed by the Hand.
Stan Gibson, killed by his son with a scalpel.
fall: An anonymous donation buys the hospital's silence, and Claire quits rather than cover it up.
Daredevil S2
Claire goes home to Harlem.
Luke Cage S1
Claire tells Danny Rand the Hand nearly killed her, and is wary of helping him at first.
Iron Fist S1

item.b: The Avengers' children grew up hiding from one robot. There was no hiding from this.
